title: A Cheaper Full-Frame Nikon That Keeps the Image Quality
excerpt: DPReview put Nikon's budget full-frame Z5IIC through its studio scene, and the verdict is plain: the same sensor as the Z5II means the same image quality. The price cut costs you a viewfinder, not your photos.

title: VSCO Says It Plainly: Your Photos Will Not Train Its AI
excerpt: After photographers called out broad terms wording in May, VSCO has rewritten its policy in plain language: your photos, public or private, will not train generative AI. The promise now covers free accounts too, and its AI providers are held to the same standard.

title: The Best Photos on Your Commute Are the Ones You Drive Past
excerpt: Rick Bebbington spent two days photographing only what he could see from the road near his home, and came back with real frames. The lesson is not about the road. It is that the places you already drive past every day are a shooting assignment waiting for a pin on the map.
